name: B10-0318/2026 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Burkina Faso's government to undo its crackdown on public life. It wants the government to let banned groups, parties and media work again, drop the death penalty, and stop jailing or abducting critics. It also asks the European Union to give more support and protection to civil society in Burkina Faso and to back a return to elected civilian rule.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects Burkina Faso's government, banned groups, parties, media and critics.
- Next, the text goes to the EU Council, Commission and Burkina Faso's authorities.
